results.title: GAFM resolves regulatory status with GTEC, clarifies professional certification role
results.content: The Global Academy of Finance and Management (GAFM), USA, says it has resolved a regulatory discrepancy with the Ghana Tertiary Education Commission (GTEC) following engagements and the submission of documents on its international recognition and professional accreditations. In a press release dated November 23, 2026, the organisation said GTEC removed it from its list of unrecognised universities on August 28, 2026, and maintained the exclusion in its subsequent September, October and November directories. GAFM said the resolution reflects its status as an international professional certification body and standards organisation, rather than a university or an institution that awards academic degrees and diplomas. It stressed that it had never sought recognition in Ghana as an academic university and did not present its professional certifications as academic qualifications.

results.title: Francis Amissah joins Martell’s Swift Academy in Accra
results.content: Ghanaian public relations consultant Francis Amissah, popularly known in entertainment circles as Banks, is set to participate in the Accra edition of Martell’s Swift Academy, an initiative aimed at supporting the development of emerging African creatives. Amissah, founder and Chief Executive Officer of Elite PR, brings more than a decade of experience in public relations and communications to the programme. Through Elite PR, he has worked with several artistes and entertainment personalities, including E.L, Wendy Shay, Zlatan, D-Black, the Mitch Brothers, Dulcie Boateng, Mark Asari and RCee. His work has focused on securing media coverage, strengthening the visibility of talent and connecting creatives with wider audiences.
